Hekkert, M.P. and Worrell, E. (1997). Technology Characterisation for Natural Organic Materials: Input data for Western European MARKAL. Report No. 98002, ISBN 90-73950-40-7, Department of Science, Technology and Society, Utrecht University, Utrecht, March 1997 [as printed; report number suggests 1998].

Locators are printed page numbers (equal to PDF pages). MARKAL input tables (2000/2020/2050 columns) for wood products, pulp and paper. Main file: each technology table loaded with the 2000 column (fuel/steam/heat and electricity per t product, investment per t capacity, O&M per t with labour in note, availability/lifetime where stated); where 2020/2050 differ a separate "2020-2050" process carries only the changed values; Tables 4.7-4.9 have values only for 2020/2050. Lumber drying (Table 3.8) per m3 dried wood (fresh air vs condensation) and PLATO wood modification (per m3 converted with stated 1 t/m3). Negative steam (export) is in flows, not SEC. Flows: steam export from TMP and nonwood pulping, black liquor and bark outputs, recovery boiler and BLG inputs/outputs, recovered paper inputs. Measures: VSD on wood drying (Table 3.9), new paper drying technologies (Tables 6.1-6.4, % changes), kraft/TMP/recycling measures. Not loaded: compost, biopolymers, natural rubber (Ch. 7), Annex I, figures. Traps: two tables numbered 4.10 and two numbered 5.3 (pp.57, 59) - locators use pages; Tables 4.3/4.4 investments labelled ECU but text derives them in USD ($145, $202); condebelt text 26% vs table 20%; steam impingement text 7% vs table 8% electricity; glulam 2000 values are not the stated average; investments derived by authors from production cost with an annuity (sawmills) or from order prices (mills); no price year. All values compiled from cited sources (Nilsson 1995, Komppa 1993, Forintek 1993, van Heijningen 1992, Fruhwald 1997, PPI 1996/1997).
